main_text.p: rorum sese obijcerent: I,II,III, IIII,V.quas ubi animaduerti, quorsumque pertinerent at tendi,studiosum illum adolescentem pudore ac uerecundia quadam affeci. Oftendi enim, quod in me Duareni auctoritate arguebat, id ipsū esse accuratè ac studiosè ab ipso Duareno eodem in li-bro factitatum. Ita quod ratione ac disputatione nō po-tuerā, facilè auctoritate per-uici. Exemplum autem hoc loco unum pro multis subij-ciam. Caius L.ult. de verb.oblig. sic scribit: Pupillus, licet « ex quo fari cœpit, rectè stipulari potest: tamen si in paren «

page.notes: Running head and page number are read from the scan; the running head's first word is partly unclear, so it is marked [?]. The catchword "tis" completes the word "parentis" split at the foot of the page. Long s is written as plain s, and hyphens are kept only where they are printed at line ends.
